key_terms.الشَّدِيدُ الْقُوَى: The Strong One / The Supreme Intellect

ai.seo_question: Who is Al-Shadid al-Qawa in Surah An-Najm?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, this epithet emphasizes the potency of the divine source of revelation, with many scholars identifying 'Al-Shadid al-Qawa' as Jibril al-Amin or the Supreme Intellect (Al-'Aql al-Kul) who conveyed the Quran to Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). This understanding underscores the direct, unmediated transmission of divine wisdom, reinforcing the Prophet's authority and the purity of the message received.
